name: Monitoring Agent
description: Autonomous RAN configuration agent that monitors live radio KPIs (current p0nominal, uplink/downlink throughput, SNR, etc.), recommends updated p0nominal values, and enforces new configuration in the RAN.

skills.description: Fetch current RAN KPIs (p0nominal, UL/DL throughput, SNR, configuration state); analyze performance; propose new p0nominal values to improve link quality and throughput; and apply/enforce the updated p0nominal to the RAN configuration.
examples: What is the current p0nominal and uplink SNR for this cell?
Recommend a new p0nominal to improve uplink performance.
Throughput is low on the downlink. Should we change p0nominal?
Apply your recommended p0nominal for this sector.
Show me KPIs (UL throughput, DL throughput, SNR) and tell me if p0nominal should be updated.
skills.name: RAN p0nominal Optimization and Enforcement
